jobs.description:
Join us in helping build the teams behind our mission. As Talent Acquisition Partner, you will lead recruitment activities across Germany and Switzerland, partnering with hiring managers to attract, assess, and hire exceptional talent while continuously improving the candidate and hiring manager experience.

Your key responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end recruitment across Germany and Switzerland
- Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and drive effective hiring decisions
- Develop and execute sourcing strategies to attract and engage top talent incl. building relationships with universities, educational institutions, and student organizations to support early-talent pipelines
- Assess candidates through structured interviews and selection processes
- Advise stakeholders on recruitment best practices, tools, and market insights
- Champion an outstanding candidate experience while contributing to the continuous improvement of our talent acquisition practices

Your experience and qualifications
For this role your ability to deliver high-quality hiring processes is more important than your educational background. We are seeking someone with extensive recruitment experience, preferably from an in-house role. Other requirements are

- Strong experience in end-to-end recruitment across different functions
- Proven sourcing and candidate research capabilities
- Strong stakeholder-management and advisory skills
- Confidence in managing several recruitment processes and priorities independently
- Fluent English, both written and spoken
- German language skills

About the team
You will report to the Talent Acquisition Manager based in Denmark and become part of a collaborative, international Talent Acquisition team. While most of the team is located in Denmark, you will also have a colleague based in the United States.

Success in this role is built on strong relationships. We are therefore looking for someone based within commuting distance of Munich who values face-to-face collaboration and enjoys partnering closely with hiring managers, business leaders, and HR colleagues. Regular time in the office will help you build your network and stay connected to the people and culture that make Bavarian Nordic unique.

You should also expect regular travel to Bern, Switzerland once per quarter to support hiring activities and strengthen collaboration across both locations.

What makes this opportunity unique?
This is a broad Talent Acquisition role with real ownership and mandate, where you will combine hands-on recruitment, proactive sourcing, stakeholder partnering, and talent pipelining across two key markets.

Ready to apply!
Then apply by clicking the ‘APPLY’ button. Please submit your CV in English - we do not ask for a cover letter.

We are interviewing on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager Consulting AI (m/f/d) (IT-Kundenbetreuer/in)
jobs.description:
We have people in mind first!

Senior Manager Consulting AI (m/f/d) in Nürnberg

Our client is a fast-growing AI technology company based in the Nuremberg area. With deep expertise in automation, artificial intelligence and digital transformation, the company develops practical AI solutions for demanding enterprise clients and supports them from strategy to implementation.

To strengthen the consulting and commercial team, we are looking for a driven and client-facing personality as Senior Manager Consulting AI (m/f/d). In this role, you will lead high-impact AI and automation projects, work closely with senior stakeholders and contribute to client development, proposal preparation and consulting delivery.

Your responsibilities as Senior Manager Consulting AI (m/f/d)

- Consulting & Delivery Leadership: Lead complex AI and automation projects from initial concept to implementation, ensuring high-quality delivery and tangible business outcomes for clients
- Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as a trusted interface for senior client stakeholders, understand business needs and translate them into clear solution approaches
- Commercial Development: Support account growth by identifying client needs, preparing proposals, RFPs and business cases, and contributing to new project opportunities, upselling and follow-on business
- Solution Design & AI Strategy: Develop digital and AI-driven solution concepts, roadmaps and business cases that improve performance, reduce costs and create measurable user value
- Project Team Coordination: Provide functional leadership to multidisciplinary project teams of consultants, developers and architects, depending on project scope and complexity
- Workshops & Trainings: Design and facilitate client workshops, training sessions and decision-making formats around automation, AI use cases and transformation topics
- Frameworks & Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the further development of delivery frameworks, governance structures, execution playbooks and consulting standards

Your Profile

- Consulting Experience: Several years of experience in consulting, ideally in IT, process, digital transformation, automation or AI-related environments
- Educational Background: Degree in business, technology, computer science, engineering or a comparable qualification
- Commercial Mindset: Strong understanding of client development, proposal preparation and the commercial side of consulting projects
- Project Leadership: Experience in leading complex projects or providing functional leadership to project teams; confident in agile ways of working and structured delivery formats
- AI & Digital Expertise: Good understanding of digital solutions, automation and AI use cases; experience with AI concepts, frameworks or implementation projects is a strong plus
- Stakeholder Communication: Confident communication with senior decision-makers, strong presentation skills and the ability to structure complex topics clearly
- Analytical & Structured Thinking: Ability to conduct qualitative and quantitative analyses, identify pain points and translate them into actionable business cases
- Personality & Drive: Curious, fast-learning and proactive personality with ownership, resilience and the ambition to create real business impact
- Language Skills: Fluent German and fluent English skills for client work, internal collaboration and international project environments

What you can expect

- Shape the Future from Day One: A key role in a young, ambitious AI company where you can actively shape consulting delivery, culture and long-term growth
- High-Impact Projects: Work on business-critical AI and automation solutions for leading companies across industries and international markets
- Commercial Ownership: Opportunity to contribute directly to account growth, proposal development and the scaling of AI consulting services
- Deep Tech Environment: Join a sharp, execution-oriented team with strong automation expertise and a clear focus on practical AI solutions
- Growth & Learning: Continuous development through internal tech webinars, consulting case reviews, external conferences, feedback and 1:1 mentoring
- Hybrid Work Model: Hybrid working options combined with close collaboration in the Nuremberg office and occasional client presence when project impact requires it
- Attractive Package: 30 vacation days, attractive compensation and additional performance-related components
- Strong Onboarding: Structured onboarding with a buddy for day-to-day questions and close support from your direct manager

What happens next

Please use the online application portal on our website to submit your documents.

Do you have any questions about the position? Pauline Thurn will be happy to answer them using the contact details provided.

Looking for a Change? Your Application Stays Confidential.

- If you are currently employed, we guarantee the highest level of confidentiality for your application.
- Telephone interviews and interviews outside regular working hours are also possible.

Sounds good?

Then apply now as Senior Manager Consulting AI (m/f/d) in Nuremberg.
We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description:
Innomotics GmbH
JobID: 7057
Location: Nürnberg
Department: IN FP&A CON

Mode of Employment: full-time

We are looking for a senior performance controller /f/m/d) to join our team at Innomotics.

The Industry-Leader of Motors and Drives
Innomotics is an industry-leading supplier of motors and large drive systems. With a trusted legacy of more than 150 years of engineering expertise, our products power all of the world's most essential industries. Today, we are bringing the #EnergyTransition to life with a portfolio that enables our customers to boost energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gases, and minimize the carbon footprints of plants.

Our Most Powerful Engine: Our People
We are a team of more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, innovators. For us, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion. As a global player operating with the spirit and speed of a mid-sized champion, the future holds unlimited opportunities for us. If you share our bold mindset to be best-in-class, we want you IN.

Your Future Role
The Senior Performance Controller supports the global financial steering and performance management of Innomotics, a EUR 3 billion international industrial company. The role provides transparent, forward-looking management insights, ensures robust planning and reporting processes, and acts as a key finance business partner to divisions, central functions and senior management.

- Lead and continuously improve global management reporting, performance analysis and executive decision support.
- Coordinate and challenge general forecasting and budgeting processes, ensuring consistency, quality and timely delivery.
- Act as the central controlling interface to divisions for month-end closing (Ultimo), forecast cycles and performance reviews.
- Develop and maintain standards for profit bridge analyses, enabling transparent explanations of profitability developments and key value drivers.
- Own global working-capital reporting and analysis, including cash-conversion drivers, risks, opportunities and improvement actions.
- Ensure alignment with Accounting, Treasury and Tax on financial reporting, accounting impacts, cash flow, liquidity, financing and tax-related topics.
- Support global cash-flow and liquidity planning, including cash-flow forecasting, scenario analysis and management recommendations.
- Take ownership of the business requirements and governance for key management-reporting tools, including Tagetik, standard reports and dashboards.
- Define and maintain relevant management KPIs, report content, calculation logic, reporting dimensions and drill-down requirements in cooperation with Finance, IT and reporting-tool owners.
- Ensure that reports and dashboards provide a clear, consistent and management-oriented view of performance across relevant dimensions, such as division, region, product portfolio, customer, project or legal entity.
- Support the ongoing enhancement, standardization and adoption of reporting tools, dashboards and self-service reporting solutions; technical development and dashboard design are performed by the relevant specialist teams.
- Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled analytics, automation and intelligent reporting to improve reporting efficiency, analytical quality and decision support.
- Deliver high-quality ad-hoc reporting, analyses, business cases and management presentations for strategic and operational decisions.

Your Profile

- University degree in Finance, Controlling, Business Administration, Economics or similar
- More than 10 years of professional experience in controlling, FP&A, business finance or performance management.
- At least 3 years of experience in a Senior Performance Controlling role or a comparable global/corporate controlling position.
- Strong expertise in management reporting, planning, forecasting, variance analysis and financial performance steering.
- Sound accounting knowledge, including a strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow and the interface between management reporting and statutory financial reporting.
- Practical experience with management-reporting systems, planning/consolidation tools and dashboard solutions; Tagetik experience or strong Tagetik knowledge is preferred.
- Experience defining KPI requirements, reporting structures and data dimensions for dashboards and management reports.
- Interest in, or practical exposure to, AI applications in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting or process automation is an advantage.
- Proven business understanding in industrial, manufacturing, electrification, automation, drives, energy or comparable technology-oriented industries.
- Experience working with international divisions and within a global matrix organization.
- Advanced analytical, financial modelling and presentation skills; strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
- Fluent in German and  English; additional languages are an advantage.

Personal Profile

- Structured, analytical and detail-oriented, with a clear focus on material business drivers.
- Digitally minded, with an interest in modern reporting, KPI governance, automation and AI-enabled Finance solutions.
- Confident communicator and constructive challenger with strong stakeholder-management skills.
- High ownership, integrity and resilience in a dynamic, deadline-driven global environment.
- Collaborative team player who can effectively connect divisions, central Finance functions, IT and senior management.

What's IN it for you (Our Benefits)

- Compensation according to the applicable collective agreements of the metal and electrical industry
- 30 days of vacation per calendar year
- Flexible working models
- Pension benefits
- Development opportunities
- Health care offerings
- Childcare subsidy
- Employer subsidy for "Deutschlandticket"
- Canteens with lower prices for employees
- Access to a benefits portal with attractive employee offers

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.
We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture. Therefore, applicants with severe disabilities are welcome and will be given special consideration if equally qualified.
We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.
Welcome to Allianz

Allianz SE is the global headquarters of the Allianz Group. Our employees reflect the Group's geographic and functional diversity. Within Allianz SE, Group Risk is responsible for monitoring and reporting on the Group's overall risk profile, supporting management to foster Allianz's financial strength and value-focused company leadership.
Within Group Risk, the Credit Risk Team is the global credit risk function, responsible for credit risk modeling & reporting, credit analysis and counterparty limit management. This role focuses on the approval of reinsurance transactions and reinsurance counterparty analysis within the Single-transaction Verification (SVT) framework.

What awaits you as Credit Risk Analyst (m/f/d)

- Take a central role in the Group credit risk closing process as one of the experts running it centrally for the entire Allianz Group, feeding quarterly and annual results as well as regulatory reporting, in close cooperation with Allianz entities and data stakeholders globally
- Further develop, monitor and validate the internal credit risk model under Solvency II and internal governance requirements, including the Allianz-specific calibration of credit risk parameters for a global insurer with multiple sources of credit risk
- Support local risk management teams in the regional entities on credit risk methodology and process questions, and act as a point of contact for other departments at Allianz SE on all credit risk matters
Contribute to the Group's credit risk limit system and approval framework, in particular the reinsurance exposure collection and approval process

What you bring as Credit Risk Analyst (m/f/d)

- University degree with strong academic results in a quantitative discipline such as Financial Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Econometrics or Quantitative Finance
- Solid quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to work on risk models and translate methodology into robust, controlled processes
- Confident handling of large data sets and modern analytical tools; an interest in developing your technical skills further (advanced programming not a prerequisite)
- Structured and reliable way of working, with the accuracy and ownership required in a regulated closing environment
- Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain quantitative topics to non-specialists (German is a plus)

Preferred qualifications:

- Practical experience in credit risk modelling, quantitative risk management or a regulatory closing process (Solvency II, IFRS 9), ideally in insurance or banking
- Professional qualification a plus - FRM, or CFA / actuarial exams (also if still in progress)
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Our highlights for you

- Health & Wellbeing: Company health insurance, sports and wellness programmes, and preventive health measures lay the foundation for your physical and mental well-being.
- Compensation: Collective agreement bonuses, a company pension plan, capital-forming benefits, and employee shares make our compensation package particularly attractive. On top of that, you directly participate in the company's success.
- Time & Flexibility: Our "New Work" model helps you achieve a better work-life balance. We work flexibly - hybrid, mobile, and on-site.
- Career Development: Together, we create a personal development plan and give you the opportunity to gain cross-functional and cross-border experience.

A full overview of what makes us an attractive employer: careers.allianz.com/benefits
